integrity: The infinite theorem is proved directly from partwise neighbor counts. Exhaustive computation through order 9 is only a regression check and is not used as an infinite certificate.
scientific_limitations: The theorem uses complete multipartite adjacency and is not asserted for general multipartite graphs with missing cross edges.
No arbitrary-complete-multipartite log-concavity or unimodality theorem is claimed.
Residual bibliographic risk remains from older literature indexed under the synonym cohesive set.
title: Strong alliance polynomial of complete multipartite graphs
